preconditions.description: The input contains exactly m + 1 lines: the first line with n and m, followed by m lines describing edges.
The number of nodes n and edges m satisfy the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 0 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range and has a non-negative weight up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: len(set(tuple(sorted((u, v))) for u, v, w in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: No pair of nodes appears more than once in the edge list.
The graph formed by the edges is connected.

postconditions.description: The output integer equals the maximum weight E_max for the first edge such that the edge belongs to at least one Minimum Spanning Tree (MST) of the graph when its weight is set to E_max.
When the first edge's weight is set to the output value, it is included in at least one MST of the graph.
If the first edge's weight is increased by 1 from the output value, it is no longer part of any MST.
